profile_text.body:
Fireflies.ai is a software company that offers an AI-based meeting assistant product, also called Fireflies.ai, which the company describes as the "#1 AI Teammate for Meetings, Email, Chat & CRM." The product is designed to record, transcribe, and summarize meetings, and can be invited to live sessions via the address fred@fireflies.ai or set to autojoin calendar meetings automatically. Beyond transcription, the platform manages tasks and automates workflows across meetings, email, chat, CRM systems, and third-party apps, and is pitched as a way to build a searchable knowledge base of a team's work in one place.

The product includes a feature set the company calls AI Skills, which can automatically extract key details from meetings, generate follow-up emails, and score candidates, among other functions. The site categorizes the product within notes, knowledge, and meetings use cases. As consent practices are relevant to meeting recording tools, users and organizations should be mindful of applicable recording consent requirements when deploying the service.
